backlog task edit APRV-279 --plan "1. examples/agentmail-demo.md: step 5's \`export DRAFT=dr_…\` and step 7's \`\"draft_id\": \"dr_…\"\` become the UUID shape AgentMail actually returns (67799b7c-…), with a line saying the id is a UUID so a reader who typed dr_ knows why nothing matched.
2. Step 9's edit becomes \`curl -sS -X PATCH …/drafts/\$DRAFT\` with the same body, and a sentence recording that POST on that path answers not_found. Step 10 gains the matching PATCH that restores the approved subject, so the runbook is paste-able end to end instead of saying 'put it back'.
3. Re-read steps 9-10 for the grant-untouched / same-token-sends promise (APRV-276 is making the code keep it). Leave it exactly as it stands; add nothing that contradicts it.
4. Confirm docs/cli-reference.md and README name no POST draft-edit (grep says the only POST either carries is .../drafts/{draft_id}/send, which is right).
5. src/channels/telegram.ts \`call()\`: the non-ok branch throws \`HTTP <status>\` and never reads the body, so the Bot API's own \`description\` is discarded. Read it (best effort, redacted, JSON or not), carry \`status\` and \`description\` on TelegramApiError, and put the description in the message: \`editMessageText: HTTP 400 (Bad Request: message is not modified)\`.
6. Export \`isMessageNotModified(cause)\`: a TelegramApiError at status 400 whose description says the message is not modified. Telegram answers that when an edit changes nothing, which is what a re-annotation of an already-annotated message is: the annotation stands and there is nothing to tell the operator.
7. Guard the four warning sites with it — channels/telegram.ts annotateDecided, redraw-the-digest and annotateQuietly, and cli/channel-telegram.ts dispatchPending's annotate catch. Every other 400 and every other status keeps its warning. No decision, log or gating path is touched; the throw still propagates, only the printing changes.
8. Tests against the injected fetch in tests/channels-telegram.test.ts (and the listener suite): a not-modified 400 is silent and costs the decision nothing; a different 400 is warned and names what the Bot API said.
9. npm run build, the telegram/channel/docs suites, npm run lint, npm run typecheck." 2>&1 | tail -3
